method: Read current source Parquet metadata columns with pyarrow; select first 20000 train and first 256 validation rows, following release manifest and adapter default shuffle=False. Counts are row counts, not unique tasks or token proportions.
limitations: Metadata labels do not constitute content-level classification. Zero ID overlap does not prove semantic decontamination. Current source and frozen release should additionally be checked by content hashes.
conclusion: This run is code-focused SFT, not the intended multi-domain mixture.
